title: Workspace activation report
description: Read-only status, explicit configure results (including bulk `--apply-all`), and undo (`revert`) for bounded Git workspace discovery. A shared declaration is never installation proof.
$comment: `summary`/`discovery`/`recently_set_up` are present on `cc workspace --all|--project [--json]` and on `configure`/`configure --apply-all`, all of which route through the CLI's `build_workspaces_report()`/`_report()` helpers. `cc workspace revert --project <path> [--apply] --json` builds its own report BY HAND and carries none of the three -- only `workspaces` (always exactly one entry) plus its own `revert` object. native/cli-dtos.swift decodes that verb's report as a SEPARATE, narrower type (`WorkspaceRevertReport`) for exactly this reason, rather than requiring fields this schema's own `revert` verb never sends.

setup_policy.description: Whether the app must ask before setting this project up. `automatic` means a project created since its root was approved, with nothing of the person's to protect and no decision only they can make -- the app applies it silently, the same way it already associates a ready project's private profile (see `recently_set_up` below for how this becomes discoverable after the fact). `excluded` is set by `revert`.

can_apply_now.description: False before the copilots this project's setup would copy from exist on this Mac (e.g. during first-run onboarding, before Set up has run). Chooses the wizard's checkbox grammar vs. the menu bar's immediate Add grammar.

recently_set_up.description: The 'Projects set up for you' record: one past-tense sentence per project the CLI set up automatically in the last 168h (newest first), purged of a project immediately once `revert` undoes it. Absent on the `configure`/`approve-root`/etc. reports that don't route through `build_workspaces_report()`; present (possibly `[]`) on `cc workspace --all|--project --json`. Drives BOTH the one-time 'New projects get your copilots automatically now' notice (shown once, ever) and the past-tense 'Projects set up for you' group in What changed -- the app holds no equivalent state itself across launches.

detail.description: The full rendered sentence, e.g. "Set your copilots up in Convoco." -- never assembled from `name` by the app.

revert.description: `cc workspace revert --project <path> --json`: what was removed and what was kept.

discovery.description: Whether this Mac has a projects folder granted, so the menu bar can offer the grant instead of silently returning nothing.

path.description: Only ever passed back to the CLI; never rendered.
